notes:
- Company profile: mid-size direct-to-consumer home + lifestyle retailer. Shopify storefront, headless product pages.
- Primary ask: on-page product Q&A widget (answer questions from product data + descriptions) and nightly catalog enrichment (auto-fill attributes, normalize colors/sizes).
- Traffic pattern: low steady traffic with weekly bursts (Fri afternoons) and seasonal spikes during promo windows — expects short spikes up to ~250-400 qps during flash sales. Wants hosted API (self-serve) to move fast.
- Latency & throughput: p50 for single-turn Q&A should be <400ms; p95 <900ms acceptable for now. Embeddings for search/rerank ok to run async (nightly or on-change).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, wants predictable unit economics and a quick estimate: "what does 10k Q&A requests / month cost". Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching/cache) to lower per-query cost.
- Model preferences: open models preferred for cost control; open to Redwood-curated variants if latency/cost tradeoffs are good. Wants an easy fallback to smaller model for peak bursts.
- Security: basic SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for admin actions, SOC2 compliance preferred. Data residency not strict (US-based).
- Integration notes: prefers SDKs + example middleware for Shopify and a small node lambda for serverless widget.
- Quote from product lead: "We need something that just works out of the box and won't blow our margins during sales."
- POC scope suggestion: 1) self-serve trial account -> integrate widget with test product page using sample dataset; 2) run 48-hour synthetic burst test (simulate flash sale); 3) evaluate accuracy on 200 golden Q&A pairs and catalog attribute fill rate.
- Risk: mapping inconsistent vendor-provided attributes will take time; may need engineering bandwidth for data cleanup.
- AE notes: prioritize sending prompt templates, simple pricing scenarios, and a short guide for generating embeddings for taxonomy normalization.
